desc:
⚔️ BIT TENSEI ✨
Be reborn in a world of magic and swords, and live a whole life one year at a time.

Every life is different. You could be born a noble elf or an orphan in a war zone. Train with the sword or awaken your magic, and chase fame, love, gold or power. Every choice shapes who you become.

🌟 FEATURES

Live from birth to old age as a Human, Elf, Dwarf and more
Master magic, swordsmanship and many other skills, and unlock special abilities as you rank up
Make friends, fall in love, start a family, and make rivals
Hundreds of random events: save a cat from a tree, survive a dungeon, or hear a strange voice in the White Space...
Pass on your legacy: your children and future lives carry your story forward
Hunt rare relics, discover hidden endings and complete your Index

How will your next life begin? 🔁

*INCREMENTAL GAME* (BIT)
